summary: Russian forces destroyed approximately 90% of Ukraine's retail warehouse infrastructure, severely disrupting logistics and supply chains. Massive drone attacks targeted Kyiv and multiple regions overnight, with over 14 air raid alerts in the capital. Ukrainian intelligence chief Budanov stated a minimum of 30,000 monthly mobilizations are required to maintain current force levels.
key_points: Russian strikes destroyed ~90% of retail warehouse infrastructure in Ukraine, requiring major logistics restructuring per Minister Vysotsky. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32829)
Nova Poshta warehouses and an industrial plant were hit in Svyatopetrovskoye near Kyiv, with additional strikes on sorting centers in Sumy. (Source: @UkraineNow/83736)
Russian drone destroyed the Khortytsia liquor plant in Zaporizhzhia with four hits, burning for three hours and destroying 3-4 million bottles. (Source: @UkraineNow/83743)
Massive drone wave targeted Kyiv region with over 14 air raid alerts totaling 13 hours, while reactive Shaheds launched from Donetsk, Bryansk, and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32813)
Budanov declared minimum 30,000 monthly mobilizations needed to sustain Ukrainian Armed Forces strength. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32830)
Ukrainian strike on Belgorod region minibus killed two and wounded six per Russian operational headquarters. (Source: @tass_agency/392509)
Kherson region lost power after Ukrainian strike on energy infrastructure per Saldo. (Source: @tass_agency/392512)
Former 47th Brigade commander Shirshin detained in Kharkiv with marijuana after criticizing command over Kursk losses. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32831)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces destroyed approximately 90% of Ukraine's retail warehouse infrastructure, severely disrupting logistics and supply chains. Massive drone attacks targeted Kyiv and multiple regions overnight, with over 14 air raid alerts in the capital. Ukrainian intelligence chief Budanov stated a minimum of 30,000 monthly mobilizations are required to maintain current force levels.

points: Agrarian Policy Minister Taras Vysotsky confirmed Russian forces destroyed ~90% of retail chain warehouse infrastructure, necessitating major logistics restructuring with increased delivery costs and reduced product selection. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32829)

Nova Poshta terminals in Svyatopetrovskoye (Kyiv region) and Sumy were struck; four KABs hit Sumy sorting center damaging three trucks, while Kyiv region warehouses and neighboring production were damaged. (Source: @UkraineNow/83736)

A Russian drone destroyed a Nova Poshta warehouse in Svyatopetrovskoye containing 60,000 books from publishers Readeat, Book.ua, Uroboros, Osnovy, and Vivat, halting Readeat's online shipments. (Source: @UkraineNow/83746)

Budanov stated Ukraine must mobilize at least 30,000 citizens monthly to maintain current force levels, calling it the minimum necessary while hoping to modify 'force mobilization' approaches. (Source: @UkraineNow/83754)
Kyiv experienced 14 air raid alerts in 24 hours totaling 13 hours 3 minutes, meaning sirens were active approximately 54% of the time per MP Zheleznyak. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32813)

Former 47th Magura Brigade battalion commander Aleksandr Shirshin was detained in Kharkiv with marijuana after publicly criticizing command for 'moronic missions' causing heavy losses in Kursk region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32831)
A territorial defense brigade commander in Kyiv region allegedly embezzled over 12 million hryvnias procuring 580 FPV drones intended for Kharkiv region personnel. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32821)
Kherson region lost electricity after Ukrainian strike on energy infrastructure per Russian-installed official Saldo. (Source: @tass_agency/392512)
Ukrainian drone attacked a minibus in Belgorod region killing two and wounding six per Russian operational headquarters. (Source: @tass_agency/392509)
Medvedev denied any mobilization plans in Russia while Putin emphasized each citizen's contribution for victory at ASI forum. (Source: @tass_agency/392507)
Russian forces struck an enterprise in Kyiv region producing chemicals for 'Flamingo' per TASS summary of Putin's statements. (Source: @tass_agency/392507)
Zakharova stated Russia received no proposals to resume negotiations on Ukraine. (Source: @tass_agency/392507)
Wildberries published reports for Russian sellers on goods damaged by UAV attacks, forming separate documents per affected facility. (Source: @tass_agency/392510)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's systematic destruction of Ukraine's retail logistics infrastructure (90% of warehouses) represents a strategic economic warfare campaign aimed at destabilizing civilian supply chains and increasing wartime inflation. The unprecedented density of drone attacks on Kyiv — 14 alerts in 24 hours with 54% siren uptime — indicates a deliberate campaign to exhaust air defenses and degrade civilian morale. Budanov's admission of a 30,000/month mobilization requirement reveals critical manpower shortages that may force controversial female mobilization and demographic policies. Simultaneous strikes on Nova Poshta hubs, the Khortytsia plant, and Epicenter hypermarkets demonstrate coordinated targeting of economic nodes. Ukrainian strikes on Belgorod and Kherson energy infrastructure show retained long-range strike capability but risk escalatory Russian responses against critical infrastructure.
sections.regional_response: Poland explicitly rejected hosting nuclear weapons despite frontline status, signaling NATO caution against nuclear escalation. CIA Director Ratcliffe's unannounced Moscow visit suggests backchannel communication amid battlefield escalation, potentially addressing nuclear red lines or prisoner exchanges. The Nepal flood tragedy killing 53 Ukrainians and 7 Russians highlights collateral humanitarian risks but lacks direct conflict nexus. Russian domestic crackdown continues with new 'foreign agent' designations for journalists and comedians, indicating regime focus on internal control. Wildberries' systematic documentation of UAV-damaged goods reflects Russian private sector adaptation to sustained air threats. No new peace initiatives emerged; Zakharova confirmed zero negotiation proposals.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Svyatopetrovskoye strikes reveal Russian intelligence tracking of Nova Poshta's dual-use logistics role; the deleted photos of UAV launcher trucks suggest Ukrainian operational security failures. Shirshin's detention for drugs after criticizing Kursk operations indicates potential command retaliation against dissenting officers. The territorial defense commander's FPV drone embezzlement (580 units, 12M UAH) exposes corruption in drone procurement chains supplying Kharkiv front. Reactive Shahed launches from Bryansk, Donetsk, and Chernihiv show dispersed launch sites complicating preemption. The 30,000/month mobilization figure aligns with estimated Ukrainian losses but exceeds demographic capacity without female conscription. Russian guided bomb strikes on Kharkiv indicate continued tactical aviation superiority in that sector.
